source.implements: data.js CHECKLIST (verify/derive.js --write), the Phase checklist table: per rule and ability, from its own words (withoutOptions): s listed (seqTrigger: a sentence naming the start or end of a battle round, turn or phase, a Command phase, or another phase with a choice, with no unit activation: selected to…, each time / when this or a unit or model…, this unit's move or attacks, makes an attack / charge / move, is targeted, targets this, destroys, is destroyed, the first time); t the phases its text names (table 1's trigger) less those only its opening moment gives and those named only as "your / the next X phase" beside another trigger (Umbralefic Crystal's ingress move), at that moment, ae a sentence at the end of the battle round (Pledges to the Dark Prince), a its own trigger a unit activation (actOf), pk where the ability it selects is in force (pickCover), u where its effect is used (table 1's used-in), limited to the trigger's phases and turn when the text names them and states no duration (no until, this turn, next, for the rest of); none: positively no phase; x: not derivable; per option (optionsOf) s, a (its own WHEN line a unit activation), its own trigger only when it names one, where it is used, x when it has neither and no trigger of its rule; g: an ability it gives units by keyword; f: what it puts in force (inForce); the same words on several units must give one entry, else x

an item's own trigger is a unit activation (a: left out as an option, or as the ability a listed one selects): its WHEN line is one; or its first sentence opens with "When" and has one (Diabolic Power), or has a "when / whenever / each time / after … selected to …" clause (Pulse Jet, Overwhelming Wrath); an effect's "Each time a model in this unit makes …" (a Blessing of Khorne) is not its trigger

the phases a duration covers from where the text is triggered, in the order of a turn and the next (Core Rules 07): end of the phase: that phase (not from the start of the battle round: no phase is in progress, x); of the turn / this turn: the rest of that turn; of the next turn: the rest of that turn and the whole next one; until the start of your next turn or Command phase: the rest of that turn, and the opponent's turn after one of yours; end of the battle: every phase (also from the end of your opponent's turn); end of the battle round: every phase only from the start of the battle round; a trigger at the start of the battle round counts as each player's Command phase, at the end of your opponent's turn as before your turn; anything else x (When unclear)
